T: The theme park ride from hell.
D: Axel tracks a counterfeiting ring to a Southern California theme park.
P: Serve the snacks when the Spider ride gets stuck.
S: Popcorn tossed in brown sugar caramel with a pinch of bicarb, baked at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15.
waiting in line for the Spider
Choux dough piped in long ridged lengths into oil at 180C, fried until crisp and golden, then rolled in cinnamon sugar while hot.
Franks on sticks dipped in a batter of cornmeal, flour, sugar, egg and buttermilk, fried at 180C for 4 minutes until deep gold. Mustard.

edition.tagline: The theme park ride from hell.
edition.cue: Serve the snacks when the Spider ride gets stuck.

s.note: Crunchy baked caramel popcorn, like the stuff at the theme park
s.how: Pop 120g kernels. Boil 150g brown sugar, 80g butter and 3 tbsp golden syrup for 4 minutes, then stir in half a tsp bicarb. Pour over the popcorn, toss and bake at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15. Cool and break up.

s.note: Cornmeal-battered franks fried on sticks, with mustard
s.how: Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk. Pat 8 franks dry and push onto sticks. Dip in batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until deep gold. Serve with mustard.

m.note: Brined smoky turkey drumsticks, roasted until falling apart
m.how: Dissolve 80g salt and 80g brown sugar in 2L water with 1 tbsp smoked paprika. Brine 4 turkey drumsticks overnight. Pat dry, rub with more paprika and roast at 150C for 2 hours until the meat pulls easily from the bone.

w.note: Glossy red toffee apples with fairy floss on the side
w.how: Push sticks into 4 apples. Boil 400g sugar, 125ml water and 1 tsp vinegar to 150C, then add a few drops of red colouring. Dip and twirl the apples, then set on baking paper. Serve with a bag of fairy floss.

d.note: Bright blue raspberry slushies that turn your tongue blue
d.how: Blitz 200ml blue raspberry cordial with 600ml cold water and 4 cups of ice in a blender until it is smooth and slushy. Pour into four cups and serve straight away with spoon straws before it melts.
